arguments.walletId: selected registry wallet id or empty generic id

returns.openingWallet: boolean while current registry lookup is pending
returns.openWallet: stable click handler; accepts optional QR fallback string and ignores a React click event

parentIntegration: ClaimCredentialDialog owner supplies active={open && showContent} and requestScopeKey={offerKey} to OID4VCIInviteDisplay and uses this same hook for mobile handoff.
childIntegration: OID4VCIInviteDisplay includes its effective selected wallet and resolved offer transport in hook context. QRCodeDisplay visibly disables its open button while pending or inactive.
compatibility: Existing mounted callers default to active=true and requestScopeKey=null.
Generic wallet transport remains a direct open of the supplied URI.
Existing protocol-only registry fallback preference is shared unchanged.
Pending requests are not cancelled at network level; stale completion cannot navigate or overwrite current pending state.
validationScope: Real OID4VCIInviteDisplay and QRCodeDisplay with mocked registry API and window.location. Exercises stale results, stale fallback rejection, direct generic transport, exact existing wallet fallback selection, and pending-click suppression.
limitations: No external navigation or wallet application opened.
No live issuer, device, or production capture qualification.
ClaimCredentialDialog parent integration is verified separately by its owner.
